title: Guide · delivery DAG runtime canary
mission: Elevá el delivery-DAG ya verificado en fixture a evidencia runtime acotada usando únicamente eventos durables CURRENT. Medí solapamiento real entre producer y QA-precompile, dependencias de verificadores y fan-in de promoción. No agregues scheduler, cola, liveness owner ni autoridad de promoción.
definition_of_done: Un canary runtime registra timestamps durables de inicio/fin de producer y QA-precompile y prueba o refuta solapamiento real sin inferirlo de estado ACTIVE.
Los verificadores independientes sólo esperan prerequisitos explícitos y los advisory-only no entran al fan-in de promoción.
Se reporta critical-path real y baseline serial equivalente con la misma unidad de trabajo, incluyendo evidencia de colisiones/retries si aparecen.
Un blocker real de promoción impide promotion-ready mientras la candidate reversible puede seguir visible/usable, sin cambiar autoridad CURRENT, Human Accepted, Served ni promoción.
La ejecución deja regression/receipt reabrible y no proclama paralelismo distribuido si faltan timestamps o si el runtime serializa las etapas.
consumer: Guide/Metabolism runtime verification through existing portfolio authority

semantic_identity.problem: delivery dag dependency/timing semantics are verified only in deterministic fixture real distributed wall-clock concurrency remains unverified
acceptance: comparison reports real wall-clock critical path against serial baseline without changing scheduler current or promotion authority
failure of a real promotion blocker prevents promotion while reversible candidate remains usable
independent verifiers wait only on explicit prerequisites and promotion fan-in excludes advisory-only checks
runtime canary records producer and qa-precompile overlapping start/finish timestamps from existing durable worker events

truth_boundary: Candidate work description only. It grants no execution, scheduling, liveness, CURRENT, acceptance, Served or promotion authority and must report unknown when durable runtime timing evidence is absent.
